reviews.text: Disappointing Experience. Terrible service. My luggage was broken, and the airline made it nearly impossible to receive compensation. Very frustrating and disappointing!

This airline is a fraud. I am extremely disappointed with my recent experience with Air France. For the second time, two of my luggages were damaged during my flight. I immediately went to the front desk at LAX as soon as I landed and filed a complaint in person. I was told I would receive a call within 2 3 weeks regarding the resolution.

A full month later, instead of receiving assistance, I was informed that my case had been closed because I “filed it too late”, which is completely untrue. I reported the damage immediately upon arrival at the airport.

The lack of accountability, poor communication, and dismissal of legitimate claims is extremely frustrating. Having luggage destroyed once is unfortunate, having it happen again and then being denied support is unacceptable. I expected better customer service and a more professional handling of baggage claims.

Constant glitches, Unreliable Widgets, Zero attention or care when it comes to user experience.. For an airline of Air France’s size and revenue, this app is shockingly unreliable. The widgets don’t work, they don’t update, and they often fail to load any flight information at all. I’ve updated the app, added flights, restarted my phone, nothing changes.

And the issues aren’t limited to the widgets. The app itself is buggy and inconsistent. Flight details don’t refresh properly even with all the correct settings enabled: Background App Refresh on, Location set to Always, notifications allowed. It still behaves like an app that hasn’t been tested in real conditions.

This isn’t a minor inconvenience, it’s a clear sign of where Air France chooses not to invest. A company that prides itself on premium service shouldn’t be delivering a digital experience that feels this cheap and neglected. If they want to be taken seriously in 2025, fixing their app should be a priority, not an afterthought.
